description: Events the daemon broadcasts to subscribed clients.

events.name: ClientDisconnectedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a client disconnects.

events.name: ConfigValueChangedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a config value changes in the Core.

events.name: CreateTorrentProgressEvent
events.summary: Emitted when creating a torrent file remotely.

events.name: ExternalIPEvent
events.summary: Emitted when the external ip address is received from libtorrent.

events.name: NewVersionAvailableEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a more recent version of Deluge is available.

events.name: PluginDisabledEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a plugin is disabled in the Core.

events.name: PluginEnabledEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a plugin is enabled in the Core.

events.name: PreTorrentRemovedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a torrent is about to be removed from the session.

events.name: SessionPausedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when the session has been paused.

events.name: SessionResumedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when the session has been resumed.

events.name: SessionStartedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a session has started.  This typically only happens once when

events.name: TorrentAddedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a new torrent is successfully added to the session.

events.name: TorrentFileCompletedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a file completes.

events.name: TorrentFileRenamedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a file within a torrent has been renamed.

events.name: TorrentFinishedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a torrent finishes downloading.

events.name: TorrentFolderRenamedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a folder within a torrent has been renamed.

events.name: TorrentQueueChangedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when the queue order has changed.

events.name: TorrentRemovedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a torrent has been removed from the session.

events.name: TorrentResumedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a torrent resumes from a paused state.

events.name: TorrentStateChangedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a torrent changes state.

events.name: TorrentStorageMovedEvent
events.summary: Emitted when the storage location for a torrent has been moved.

events.name: TorrentTrackerStatusEvent
events.summary: Emitted when a torrents tracker status changes.
